prompt: I have never opened this project before. Give me a high-level characterization of the whole thing: how large it is, which languages it uses, and where execution starts.
rationale: A whole-repository characterization is code_insight; index_stats reports ingestion counts only and git_analysis reports the quality of a git change set, not the shape of the repository.
answer_key_evidence: Comprehensive codebase intelligence system for AI agents
